name: llull-desktop
description: llull desktop app: the web app + local backend (server/) + CLI + Python/CadQuery in one installable, offline app

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:main
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run stage:server && npm run prepare:python && npm run prepare:native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.test: npm --prefix ../server run --silent bundle && vitest run --config vitest.config.mts
